Why Choose ABC?

For nearly 30 years, ABC has been making solutions designed to fit seamlessly into your instruction. Our pretest and Chart of Standards allow quick identification of individual learning gaps, every chapter contains excellent instructional content and practice via review questions, and a posttest is included to confirm mastery of all concepts.

Each order includes student coursebooks, a free teacher's guide, and access to our CourseWave digital platform for eBooks and online testing.

Included in Every Order:

Coursebooks

All ABC content maps directly to state blueprints. The questions on the full-length pre and posttests simulate state assessments, and are labeled with DOK level and standard for easy concept identification.

CourseWave eBooks & Online Testing

Built in analytics give teachers the data they need to identify learning gaps while students gain familiarity and confidence with both online testing and the tested material.

Teacher's Guide

Your included teacher's guide is not only the answer key for all tests and quizzes, but also offers additional reproducible assessments not included in the student coursebook.
